entities.summary: Lee Joseph "Bru" Archambault is an American test pilot and former NASA astronaut. He has logged over 4,250 flight hours in more than 30 different aircraft. Archambault is married with three children. His hobbies include bicycling, weightlifting, and playing ice hockey. Archambault has received numerous awards and honors throughout his life. He has also flown two Space Shuttle missions, as pilot of STS-117 in 2007 and as commander of STS-119 in 2009. Archambault left NASA in 2013 after a 15-year career with the agency in order to become a test pilot for Sierra Nevada Corporation on their Dream Chaser orbital spaceplane project.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: As a NASA astronaut with two Space Shuttle missions and over 4,250 flight hours, Lee Archambault contributed to significant advancements in space exploration. His experience as pilot of STS-117 and commander of STS-119 helped pave the way for future orbital spaceplane projects.
